files.content:
# G PC Health 0.17.1 — readable diagnostics candidate

Findings are primary; action rows are compact and every selected row retains full selectable, scrollable details. Seven metric cards adapt to client width; available RAM<=8 is critical,<=15 warning, unknown neutral, and security coverage remains visible. Resizable panes retain minimums; available-work-area clamping and main scrolling keep short-screen controls reachable; full security coverage/override text wraps, scrolls and copies; auxiliary bounds clamp. Only fourteen specified resource values change literal newline escapes. Action IDs, execution/confirmation, UAC, worker/temp and protection behavior remain unchanged.

Prepared source candidate, not a production release. Each reviewed stage has two approved Windows CI routes: immutable pilot push builds the exact candidate EXE with checksum and synthetic layout evidence; required PR validation tests the actual integration checkout, whose SHA/tree and merge/base identities must be recorded separately. Four PR cycles plus four single-SHA artifact cycles and two historical charges total CI10; no unimplemented four-SHA producer is assumed. Windows11 pilot and explicit owner integration approval remain mandatory; main/merge/production release are not authorized by this document.

Current Q5 fixture correction removes Fit-before-Size false-negative and explicitly covers nonzero initial location. No diagnostic/action/UAC semantics change. Native validation and product QUALITY remain pending.


## UI feedback correction, 2026-10-09

The uploaded 1208x930 screenshot shows four stacked content panes and scarce table space. The candidate now puts headline metrics and execution context in Overview, findings in Recommendations, and selectable remedies in Actions. Details start collapsed and expand with the details button or a row double-click. Findings use compact rows and retain complete selectable detail text. Stable tab names replace position-based localization and action-bar placement. The main shell reserves a non-scrolling footer with wrapping buttons and a separate collection-status row; only Overview and the individual data/detail panes scroll. No minimum 860-pixel content height remains. Minimum requested window size is 800x600 subject to available-work-area clamping.

The revised synthetic Windows fixture covers RU/EN at 800x600, 800x720, 950x768, 1320x720 and 1320x1000, checks footer visibility without any scrolling across all tabs and after Overview scrolling, and requests 30 current-invocation renders of the separate findings/actions/security pages. New Windows checks are NOT_RUN until an actual Windows process executes them. Cross-compilation and an independently inspected PE are artifact evidence only, not runtime acceptance. The original unresolved publication intent/guard is preserved; this is an isolated candidate, not integration or production release.

# Readable tabs implementation plan

> **For agentic workers:** Use executing-plans for this bounded layout correction; keep guarded source refs unchanged.

**Goal:** Readable recommendations and reachable controls in an ordinary window.
**Architecture:** Overview owns header/context/metrics; Recommendations owns findings; Actions owns action selection. MainShell owns tabs and a fixed footer. Selected-row details are collapsed by default and retain complete copyable content when opened.
**Tech Stack:** C# .NET 8 Windows Forms, existing resource files and self-test harness.
**Spec:** User feedback 2026-10-09 and uploaded 1208x930 screenshot; chosen layout recorded in docs/releases/0.17.1.md.

## Global constraints

- CDC remains pinned to 2.12.1; no guarded source/pilot/intent/lease moves.
- UAC, nonce/session validation, same-user Temp rules and action execution remain unchanged.
- Cross-publish does not establish Windows, DPI, RDP or production acceptance.

## Review focus

- 800x600 with all footer buttons and collection status visible.
- RU/EN live language switching uses stable tab identities.
- Large selected-row text stays complete and copyable.
- Hidden action availability/reason/scope facts remain in details.
- Adding the actual main menu must not overlap content or move the footer off-screen.

### Task 1: Layout and regression fixtures

Files: MainForm.cs, MainForm.ReadableLayout.cs, MainForm.Localization.cs, MainForm.ExecutionContext.cs, MainForm.ServiceDeskActions.cs; MainStrings RU/EN; ReadableLayoutSelfTest.cs, SecurityPostureUiSelfTest.cs; Test-ReadableLayout.ps1; release notes.

- [x] Prepare Windows assertions for separate tabs, collapsed detail panes and fixed visible footer before changing layout.
- [ ] Execute baseline RED in Windows; unavailable locally, NOT_RUN.
- [x] Replace stacked findings/actions with dedicated named tabs and isolate Overview scrolling.
- [x] Keep footer buttons and status in separate rows outside scrolling.
- [x] Adapt localization, security navigation and service-desk placement.
- [ ] Compile with warnings as errors in configured compute; inspect exact resulting PE/hash.
- [ ] Run Windows synthetic/render and existing Quick/Full gates.
- [ ] Obtain independent required reviews and managed Windows11 pilot before integration/publication.
